local function C4507f5bb2e204d2f9f2270ac5840409()
local script = Instance.new("LocalScript", Moon_1)
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local runService = (game:GetService("RunService"));

local gui = script.Parent

local dragging
local dragInput
local dragStart
local startPos

function Lerp(a, b, m)
	return a + (b - a) * m
end;

local lastMousePos
local lastGoalPos
local DRAG_SPEED = (8); -- // The speed of the UI darg.
function Update(dt)
	if not (startPos) then return end;
	if not (dragging) and (lastGoalPos) then
		gui.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, Lerp(gui.Position.X.Offset, lastGoalPos.X.Offset, dt * DRAG_SPEED), startPos.Y.Scale, Lerp(gui.Position.Y.Offset, lastGoalPos.Y.Offset, dt * DRAG_SPEED))
		return 
	end;

	local delta = (lastMousePos - UserInputService:GetMouseLocation())
	local xGoal = (startPos.X.Offset - delta.X);
	local yGoal = (startPos.Y.Offset - delta.Y);
	lastGoalPos = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, xGoal, startPos.Y.Scale, yGoal)
	gui.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, Lerp(gui.Position.X.Offset, xGoal, dt * DRAG_SPEED), startPos.Y.Scale, Lerp(gui.Position.Y.Offset, yGoal, dt * DRAG_SPEED))
end;

gui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = gui.Position
		lastMousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()

		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

gui.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragInput = input
	end
end)

runService.Heartbeat:Connect(Update)

end

coroutine.wrap(C4507f5bb2e204d2f9f2270ac5840409)()

local function C232024455cb2463393a7c3ebb586413()
local script = Instance.new("LocalScript", ScrollingTextbox_1)
local textArea = script.Parent.Field
local scrollFrame = script.Parent


textArea.Changed:Connect(function(prop)
	if prop == "Text" or prop=="TextFits" then
		while textArea.TextFits == false do
			scrollFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, scrollFrame.CanvasSize.Y.Offset + 16)
			--scrollFrame.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, scrollFrame.CanvasSize.Y.Offset - scrollFrame.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y)
			task.wait()
		end
	elseif prop=="TextBounds" then
		if scrollFrame.CanvasSize.Y.Offset > textArea.TextBounds.Y + 16 then
			scrollFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, textArea.TextBounds.Y)
			--scrollFrame.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, scrollFrame.CanvasSize.Y.Offset - scrollFrame.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y)
		end
	end
end)

end

coroutine.wrap(C232024455cb2463393a7c3ebb586413)()

local function C5130b10658104555816994862d15c05()
local script = Instance.new("LocalScript", Inject_1)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
button = script.Parent

local screenGui = playerGui:WaitForChild("XMOONX")
script.Parent.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local susNames = {"remoteevent","RemoteEvent", "backdoor", "exploit", "admin", "re", "cmd", "script"}
	local backdoorParents = {game.ReplicatedStorage,game.ServerScriptService,game.ServerStorage,} 
	local foundBackdoors = false

	local function issuspicious(name)
		name = name:lower()
		for _, sus in pairs(susNames) do
			if string.find(name, sus) then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function printprogress(msg, times, delayTime)
		for i = 1, times do
			print(msg)
			task.wait(delayTime)
		end
	end

	print("[Moon] fully working âœ…")
	printprogress("--backdoor scanning--", 20, 0.05)

	print("[Moon] Starting deep scan...")
	for percent = 0, 100, 5 do
		print(string.format("[Moon] Getting backdoor %d%% ..", percent))
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	for _, parent in pairs(backdoorParents) do
		for _, obj in pairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
			if (obj:IsA("RemoteEvent") or obj:IsA("BindableEvent")) and issuspicious(obj.Name) then
				foundBackdoors = true
				task.wait(0.2)
			end
		end
	end
	for _, obj in pairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
		if (obj:IsA("RemoteEvent") or obj:IsA("BindableEvent")) and issuspicious(obj.Name) then
			foundBackdoors = true
			print("[Moon] Backdoor exist: " .. obj:GetFullName())
			task.wait(0.2)
		end
	end

	if not foundBackdoors then
		print("[Moon] Backdoor does not exist in this game")
	end
end)
end
